runtime.name: node
runtime.source: docs do not say; a newcomer installs the current LTS

knownFailures.signature: npm error ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree
knownFailures.cause: Current npm refuses the project's conflicting peer dependencies (older npm versions only warned); the lockfile resolves with --legacy-peer-deps.
The scripts call `nodemon`, but it isn't a dependency of the project: the docs assume it is installed globally.

knownFailures.signature: Error [MongoError]: failed to connect to server [127.0.0.1:27017] on first connect [Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:27017
knownFailures.cause: The app connects to MongoDB on localhost:27017, but the docs never start it.
The app connects to Redis on localhost:6379, but the docs never start it.

knownFailures.signature: [ERROR] :: TypeError: OAuth2Strategy requires a clientID option
knownFailures.cause: The app's MongoDB driver uses legacy opcodes that MongoDB 6 and later removed ("Unsupported OP_QUERY command"), so it connects but every write fails. The docs don't say which MongoDB to run; the driver needs 4.4 or older.
knownFailures.fix: MongoDB 4.4 (this project's driver can't talk to MongoDB 6+): docker run -d -p 27017:27017 mongo:4.4
